title: mirrorboard.toml
description: One organization's mirrorboard: who owns it, which definitions it uses and which department files it consists of.

name.description: The organization's name as people read it.

owner.description: The organization's account on the chain, e.g. account://kancelaria-mania-piotrowska.

accounts.description: Accounts on the chain this mirrorboard refers to; the key is used in addresses like account://<key>.

name.description: Who or what the account is, as people read it.

chain.description: The account's name on the chain.

definitions.description: Definition repositories; the key is the scheme of addresses like def+kancelaria://spec/positions/...

rev.description: The pinned commit, so every deploy takes the same definitions.

departments.description: Department files; the key is the department's name in addresses like agent://<department>/<agent>.

department.description: Path of the department file, relative to this file.
